goal: Implement the accepted NBA 2K27 MyPLAYER optimizer plan as a standalone Node 24 application in /tmp/opencode/nba2k27-myplayer, through a fake-tested BlueStacks UI adapter, without live emulator or network operation.
deliverables: A standalone package with closed schemas, typed domain contracts, deterministic replay/manual capture, black-box optimization, structured reports, security controls, and a fake-tested BlueStacks UI adapter.
Automated tests, synthetic fixtures, operator/data/optimization documentation, and independent command-backed validation for each implementation body and final integration.
nonGoals: No live BlueStacks, NBA 2K HQ, ADB, account, credential, app, or network operation.
No network diagnostic adapter, TLS interception, certificate installation, pinning bypass, private endpoint replay, publication, or Git mutation.
No changes to the OpenCode harness source, package, manifest, configuration, or runtime behavior.

acceptanceGates.criterion: The standalone package, closed schemas, vocabulary, evidence/context facts, semantic validation, and synthetic fixtures implement the accepted plan contracts.
Hard partitioning, soft priorities, context cache, deterministic proposals, Pareto and near-tie behavior, confidence, stopping, and replay invariants are tested.
Replay/manual capture and JSON/Markdown reports are deterministic, provenance-preserving, and correctly expose satisfied, missed, unknown, costs, confidence, assumptions, and deltas.
State recognition, preflight, approval, redaction, fake host transport, and bounded UI planning/execution fail closed without live host access.
CLI validation, replay optimization, deterministic manifest replay, docs, package checks, and the complete offline suite pass with no live or network dependency.
Implementation contains no network adapter and performs no live emulator, app, account, credential, source-harness, or Git mutation.
